title: Annotatio VI §.III close: Faxit Deus — end mutual hatreds; return to full καταλλαγή — TANTUM before Coena Hexas
pass_a_gloss: May God Almighty grant that, as I now put an end to the Annotations on the Author’s Historical and Catallactic Protheoria of Controversies with the Lutherans, so an end may at last be put to the mutual hatreds of Evangelicals, that every handle for a History of these things may thenceforth be cut off, and that they themselves may return to a full and perfect καταλλαγή, to be glued more and more to their Common Head, Christ. TANTUM.
pass_b_english: May Almighty God grant that, as I now end these Annotations on the Author’s Historical and Catallactic Protheoria of controversies with the Lutherans, so an end may at last be put to Evangelicals’ mutual hatreds.
Then every handle for a history of these fights may be cut off, and they may return to a full and perfect καταλλαγή — glued more and more to their common Head, Christ.
TANTUM. Stop before HEXAS Annotationum on the Prior Protestant Controversies De Coena Domini (Annotatio I).
source_text:
Faxit DEus O. M. ut sicuti Annotationibus in Protheoriam Autoris Historicam & Catallacticam Controversiarum cum Lutheranis, nunc finem impono, ita finis tandem imponatur odiis Evangelicorum mutuis, ut Historiae de his ansa omnis deinceps praescindatur, ipsi verò ad plenam perfectamque καταλλαγήν redeant, magis magisque Capiti suo Communi, Christo, conglutinandi.
TANTUM.
notes: Faxit Deus; καταλλαγή; TANTUM; stop before Coena Hexas.
